name: Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel
label: Quest
description: In Kharanos, the Thunderbrew family's ale rests under guard in the distillery cellar. The watch protects their prized stock from thieves and rivals.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Kharanos, the Thunderbrew family's ale rests under guard in the distillery cellar. The watch protects their prized stock from thieves and rivals.

Jarven Thunderbrew keeps watch over the Thunderbrew family's ale in the cellar beneath their distillery in Kharanos. In Dun Morogh, the family trusts no one with its stock; sentries stand beside the aging casks to keep anyone from tampering with or siphoning away the brew.

The Thunderbrews take pride in their proprietary recipes, especially their potent batches of Thunder Ale. Dwarves treat brewing with the care they give smithing and mining. Troggs creep through Dun Morogh, and brewing rivals compete across the Alliance. Jarven watches the casks so the family's ale stays untouched until it is ready to be tapped.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This barrel of ale is guarded by Jarven Thunderbrew. As long as he's in the basement, no barrels may be disturbed.
